methods: Independent source inspection of help, guest contact/receipt, private Job Loop support, admin queues, erasure and run-control contracts.
Read-only HTTP GET of https://jobvance.io/help and https://jobvance.io/contact: both 200, expected task/support wording present in initial HTML. No interactive production workflow was exercised.
npm run test:run -- src/__tests__/help-center.test.tsx src/__tests__/guest-support.test.tsx src/__tests__/lib/guest-support-boundary.test.ts --maxWorkers=4: 3 files, 30 tests passed.
Deterministic evaluation of HelpCenter topic data with its literal every-word filter for common support queries.
Read support/privacy/recovery sections of docs/INTEGRATED-JOB-LOOP-OPERATIONS.md; operational instructions treated as documentation, not proof of staff execution.
not_tested: No live support submission, receipt lookup, administrative private record read, reply/status write, account sign-in or erasure.
No customer response-time, case quality, satisfaction, live interactive browser or actual authenticated download measurement.
No paid model/search/media calls, service activation, runtime fixes or external messages.
Current configured provider/Gmail/scheduler availability was not queried; UI/source capability contracts were reviewed.

criteria.name: Task self-service
criteria.evidence: HelpCenter.tsx defines 12 task topics covering no CV, formats/OCR, evidence, approval, transfers, recovery and run availability; literal query gaps confirmed from its topic/filter data.

criteria.name: Accessible intake and expectations
criteria.evidence: GuestSupport.tsx:15-18 provides anonymous consented intake, downloadable private receipt, explicit 90-day expiry, no-email and no-response-time statements; public initial HTML verified.

criteria.name: Resolution and candidate feedback
criteria.evidence: Guest reply/readback implemented; LoopSupport.tsx:14 and job-loop-repository.ts:62 expose only original message/status, while AdminOperations.tsx:33-35 can only update private status.

criteria.name: Founder triage and escalation
criteria.evidence: Audited queues, versioned updates and run controls exist; operations instructions still name only private table, and AdminOperations.tsx:39-46 summary excludes guest queue.

criteria.name: Privacy-safe recovery
criteria.evidence: Loop erasure scope, temporary recovery limits and private message controls are explicit; full-account and interrupted-erasure operator completion checklist remains under-specified in operating instructions.

strengths: Detailed public next-click instructions for all major candidate task families, with useful OCR/no-CV/manual fallback guidance.
Anonymous support has no signup/email requirement, explicit manual-review ownership, downloadable bearer receipt and honest expectations.
Guest receipt secret is hashed server-side; private messages are omitted from queue metadata/audit payloads and explicit staff reads are audited.
Source/approval/download invalidation and loop-versus-account deletion scope are communicated without guaranteeing recovery, job results or staff response times.

findings.problem: Authenticated Job Loop support can be marked resolved without conveying an explanation or next step to the candidate. This is a source-confirmed implementation limitation, not an observed real-customer delivery failure.

evidence.detail: Candidate receipt renders category, original message, status, reference and creation time; no administrator reply.
Private support action is status-only; guest inbox separately supports reply text.
Support snapshot selects id, category, message, status, created_at, with no reply field.
Guest receipt holder can read the administrator reply, providing an existing pattern to reuse.

findings.recommendation: Add an owner-bound private support reply and updated timestamp through an additive schema/API/UI change, audited and versioned like guest support. Require a disposition before resolving.
acceptance_criteria: Fictional authenticated candidate reads the founder's saved explanation and next action in their own receipt.
Another account cannot read or modify the request/reply.
Reply/status changes reject stale versions, are audited, and do not trigger email or a model call.
Resolve records a useful disposition rather than only changing status.
findings.cost_effect: No new service, subscription or paid model cost; uses current database/admin UI.

findings.problem: Whole-account erasure and interrupted loop-erasure completion are identified but lack an executable founder procedure. No actual failed erasure was observed.

evidence.detail: Loop erase correctly retains sign-in and separate workspace records and directs account-wide requests to support.
Instructions require separate account/workspace scope review but do not detail identity, inventory, completion readback or operator ownership.
Erasure begins by stopping/revoking loop processing, then lists/removes artifacts, then finishes; scan guard can require retry or owner support.

findings.recommendation: Write a founder-owned identity/scope/inventory/deletion/readback checklist covering separate workspace, storage, Auth, provider copies and retention; explicitly handle partial completion and communicate what remains. Guest receipt possession must not establish account ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Fictional dry run covers loop-only and whole-account requests, verified account ownership and explicit requested scope.
Interrupted storage removal produces a tracked retry and no false completed-erasure response.
Completion records checked stores and explains remaining downloads/Gmail/provider/required-retention scope accurately.
Checklist requests no password, full CV or unnecessary identity material.
dependencies: Privacy/engineering review of actual stores and retention
Approved deletion tooling and fictional test account
findings.cost_effect: No new subscription; reduces repeated manual investigation and unsafe ad hoc deletion.

findings.problem: Literal every-word help search misses common support language and sign-in has no dedicated public help topic.

evidence.detail: Search requires every whitespace-delimited word to occur in the topic's literal text.

Deterministic evaluation of current topic data/filter: forgot password, login, evidence mismatch, cost hold and budget returned []; lost draft returned job-loop-review; scanned PDF returned uploads. This was local analysis, not live search UI.
Password reset already exists, including embedded free-check instructions that preserve the open check.

findings.recommendation: Add concise sign-in recovery guidance and a curated alias map for lost draft, login/password, evidence mismatch and budget/cost holds. Route to existing task instructions rather than building a chatbot.
acceptance_criteria: Common tested phrases return the intended task first.
Lost draft prioritizes recovery, cost hold/budget prioritizes preparation controls, and evidence mismatch prioritizes source/fact review.
Scanned PDF still reaches uploads; all help remains readable without an account.
Sign-in guidance distinguishes configuration/network problems from password reset and does not request passwords.
findings.cost_effect: No paid search/chat service; expected support deflection is a hypothesis to validate in pilot.

findings.problem: The documented daily routine omits guest support, and the admin review total covers private requests only. This can make the founder's understanding of work incomplete; no ignored request or backlog was observed.

evidence.detail: Daily instruction names Table Editor/job_loop_support_requests rather than current two-queue admin interface.
received and inReview counts derive from snapshot.operations.support; guest inbox is rendered separately.
Guest list returns latest 100 unexpired receipts ordered by creation; no unresolved-age prioritization.
No private queue history or founder routine was inspected; actual missed cases, response times and backlog are unknown.

findings.recommendation: Use one founder checklist at /admin/operations covering guest and private queues, separate unresolved counts/oldest age, owner/next-action/disposition and safe escalation. Prefer unresolved-first views over newest-only growth; keep private text outside analytics.
acceptance_criteria: Daily internal checklist explicitly checks both guest and private queues without creating a public response-time guarantee.
Admin shows queue scope and separate received/in-review/oldest-unresolved indicators.
A fictional older unresolved guest case remains findable after newer resolved cases.
Founder's closure record includes actual action, candidate next step and completion evidence.
findings.cost_effect: No recurring software expense; founder review time should be measured during the ten-person pilot.

open_questions: What founder review cadence and backup owner can actually be sustained? No public SLA should be added before staffing is known.
Does the founder currently answer private support through another explicitly authorized channel? None is represented in the reviewed private support contract.
Which account/workspace/provider retention obligations and approved erasure tools are operational today? The report does not make legal-compliance claims.
Which task phrases and support resolutions recur in the consenting ten-person pilot? Measure anonymized categories and successful recovery before adding automation.
do_not_build_now: Live chat or an implied human availability/response guarantee.
A separate paid support chatbot or paid chat-service subscription.
Different support products or queues for each persona.
Automatic paid retries, provider switching or cap increases as a support workaround.
Promises to restore expired memory-only drafts, verify qualifications, submit applications or recall downloaded/Gmail copies.
